title: H3D API and Novint Falcon haptic toolchain
description: The study's software-hardware stack: H3D, an open-source API that "provides a link between the graphics and haptics rendering, allowing haptic devices to interact with 3D rendered objects," with rapid prototyping, X3D compatibility, and Python scripting for node properties and event handling. The hardware is the Novint Falcon controller, a consumer-grade haptics 3D mouse with a 4"x4"x4" working volume, sub-millimeter resolution, 1ms per instruction, and approximately two pounds maximum force in any direction.
requirements: Open-source APIs and affordable consumer haptic hardware for rapid prototyping of visuo-haptic simulations
constraints: The Falcon's maximum force is approximately two pounds in any direction, as printed in the article
target_learning_goals: learning abstract physics concepts through touch and 3D visualization
examples: The Coriolis simulation was built with H3D and X3D files with Python-scripted node logic, deployed on the Novint Falcon in a science laboratory setup
